# QQ Music Charts, Albums and Playlists Scraper

QQ Music (QQ音乐) is one of mainland China's largest streaming catalogs, run by Tencent. This actor turns a search term, song link, chart, album or playlist into structured track metadata — titles, singers, album art, duration and file-size info — without needing to log in.

## What this actor does

- Searches QQ Music by free-text query, including Chinese-language queries
- Fetches full song metadata from one or more song URLs, optionally including a lyric excerpt
- Pulls any of QQ Music's 20 top-100 chart types (hot songs, new songs, rising, rap, EDM, Douyin hits, anime, game soundtracks, and more), with a summary record plus the full track list
- Fetches an album's or playlist's own metadata together with its full track list, by ID or by URL
- Filters returned songs by duration range, title keyword and singer keyword
- Omits any field the source record didn't carry — no empty strings or nulls in the output
- Never fails silently on a bad song/album/playlist reference — it returns an error record instead so you can see what didn't resolve

## Output: per song (`mode = search / bySongUrl / byToplist / byAlbum / byPlaylist` track rows)

- `mid`, `mediaMid`, `songId` — QQ Music's song identifiers
- `name` — song title
- `singers[]`, `singer` — all credited singers, and the first one as a convenience field
- `singerMids[]`
- `album`, `albumId`, `albumMid`, `coverUrl`
- `durationSec`
- `pubTimeSec`, `pubTimeText` — release time, when QQ Music provides it
- `vid` — linked music-video ID, when one exists
- `size128`, `size320`, `sizeFlac` — file size in bytes for each available audio quality
- `payPlay`, `payDownload`, `payStatus` — whether the track requires a paid plan to stream or download
- `lyric` — first part of the LRC lyric text, only when `includeLyric` is on (mode=bySongUrl)
- `sourceUrl`, `scrapedAt`, `recordType: "song"`

## Output: per chart (`mode = byToplist`, summary record)

- `toplistId`, `name`
- `listenCount`
- `coverUrl`
- `updateFrequency`, `updateTime`
- `sourceUrl`, `scrapedAt`, `recordType: "toplist"`

## Output: per album (`mode = byAlbum`, summary record)

- `albumId`, `albumMid`, `name`, `singer`
- `timePublic` — release date
- `genre`, `language`, `description`, `company`
- `trackCount`
- `sourceUrl`, `scrapedAt`, `recordType: "album"`

## Output: per playlist (`mode = byPlaylist`, summary record)

- `playlistId`, `name`, `coverUrl`
- `creatorName`, `creatorUin`, `creatorAvatarUrl`
- `listenerCount`, `visitCount`, `songCount`
- `description`, `tags[]`
- `createTimeMs`, `updateTimeMs`
- `sourceUrl`, `scrapedAt`, `recordType: "playlist"`

## Output: per unresolved reference (`recordType: "error"`)

- `errorCode` — e.g. `BAD_URL`, `NOT_FOUND`, `INVALID_INPUT`
- `errorMessage` — human-readable reason
- `inputValue` — the song URL, album ID, playlist ID or toplist ID that didn't resolve
- `scrapedAt`

## Input

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | string | `search` | `search`, `bySongUrl`, `byToplist`, `byAlbum` or `byPlaylist` |
| `searchQuery` | string | `周杰伦` | Free-text search query (mode=search) |
| `songUrls` | array | `[]` | QQ Music song URLs to fetch (mode=bySongUrl) |
| `toplistId` | string | – | Chart to fetch — one of 20 QQ Music top-100 charts (mode=byToplist) |
| `includeToplistInfo` | boolean | `true` | Emit the chart's summary record before its tracks (mode=byToplist) |
| `albumId` | integer | – | Numeric album ID (mode=byAlbum) |
| `albumUrls` | array | `[]` | Album URLs, as an alternative to `albumId` (mode=byAlbum) |
| `playlistId` | string | – | Playlist disstid (mode=byPlaylist) |
| `playlistUrls` | array | `[]` | Playlist URLs, as an alternative to `playlistId` (mode=byPlaylist) |
| `includeLyric` | boolean | `false` | Attach a lyric excerpt to each song record (mode=bySongUrl) |
| `minDurationSec` | integer | – | Drop songs shorter than this |
| `maxDurationSec` | integer | – | Drop songs longer than this |
| `containsKeyword` | string | – | Keep only songs whose title contains this substring |
| `singerKeyword` | string | – | Keep only songs whose first singer contains this substring |
| `maxItems` | integer | `30` | Hard cap on emitted records, including error records (1–1000) |

### Example: search by artist name

```json
{
  "mode": "search",
  "searchQuery": "周杰伦",
  "maxItems": 20
}
```

### Example: a specific chart with its tracks

```json
{
  "mode": "byToplist",
  "toplistId": "26",
  "includeToplistInfo": true,
  "maxItems": 100
}
```

### Example: album tracks by ID

```json
{
  "mode": "byAlbum",
  "albumId": 20612,
  "maxItems": 50
}
```

### Example: song lookup with lyrics

```json
{
  "mode": "bySongUrl",
  "songUrls": ["https://y.qq.com/n/ryqq/songDetail/001Bbywq2gicae"],
  "includeLyric": true
}
```

## Use cases

- **Music data research** — collect structured chart history for Mandarin-pop and C-pop analysis
- **Playlist curation tools** — pull track lists from public playlists into your own catalog
- **A&R and trend tracking** — monitor which songs are rising on QQ Music's charts
- **Catalog enrichment** — attach QQ Music album art, duration and singer credits to an existing song database
- **Lyric research** — fetch LRC excerpts alongside track metadata for a known set of songs

## FAQ

**Is this affiliated with QQ Music or Tencent?**
No. This is an independent actor that reads QQ Music's publicly available song, chart, album and playlist pages; it is not operated by or affiliated with Tencent or QQ Music.

**Why do some playlists return zero tracks?**
Some user-created playlists on QQ Music only serve their track list to logged-in accounts. When that happens, this actor still returns the playlist's own summary record with a `songCount` of whatever is visible publicly, rather than failing the run.

**What's in `size128`, `size320` and `sizeFlac`?**
These are the file sizes, in bytes, for each audio quality QQ Music offers for that track. A quality tier that the track doesn't have available is simply omitted.

**Why would I get an `error` record instead of song/album/playlist data?**
If a song URL, album ID or playlist ID you supplied doesn't resolve to a real QQ Music record, the actor returns an error record carrying the offending input rather than silently skipping it.

**Can I fetch artist pages directly?**
No — this actor covers search, song, chart, album and playlist lookups; it does not expose a dedicated artist/singer mode.

**Do I need a QQ account or API key?**
No login or key is required for any mode.

**How fresh are the chart rankings?**
Each run reads QQ Music's live chart and catalog pages, so rankings and track lists reflect whatever QQ Music is currently showing.
